name: python-prim-mst
title: Prim Minimum Spanning Tree
blurb: minimum spanning trees over small nonneg-weight undirected integer-keyed graphs: the grower's tree total equals the shipped enumeration oracle's minimum on every shipped and seeded corpus, every tree spans every node exactly once with |V|-1 edges, and equal weights pick the same edge set run after run.
default_description: A spanning-tree grower whose total is the enumeration oracle's minimum on every small undirected graph, and whose tree spans every node exactly once.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a node joins the tree once, through the cheapest crossing edge
